title: 04 Headway: notes
strengths: A real idea carried to the end: station signage, yellow on black, square line badges, hard rules, one condensed family at five sizes.
The giant '2' answers the only question; the stop line with a you-are-here marker explains distance without words.
Believable rows: 7 Northgate 9 MIN, 12 Harbour 14 MIN.
slop_signals: The rotated vertical 'MIN' is a signage gimmick that sits against the countdown's left edge.
Three ideas on one small display (countdown, stop diagram, departure list), and the list rows are 42 px, under the 44 pt target, so they cannot be tapped.
fixes: Set 'MIN' horizontally under the '2' at 14 px.
Make the rows 44 px and drop the stop diagram, or keep the diagram and move the list to a second page.

references.what: Line badge, destination and times with live arcs, the line colour as the page: the same signage logic.
Square line badges before each time in a list of tappable rows.
Live Activity: a countdown line under two codes; one idea per surface.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay
